title: Business Support Administrator
company: CBSbutler Holdings Limited trading as CBSbutler - Agency - Permanent
description:
Business Management Administrator

Location: Farnham
Working pattern: Permanent Role - Hybrid

The Role

Our client is looking for an organised, proactive and reliable Business Management Administrator to join its Farnham office.

This is a varied administrative position, providing essential support to the wider business management team and helping ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office.

You will be responsible for maintaining accurate records, coordinating administrative processes, supporting colleagues and responding to client enquiries. The role would suit an experienced administrator who enjoys taking ownership of their workload, keeping things organised and providing a high standard of administrative support.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing general administrative support to the Business Management team and wider office.
- Maintaining accurate, organised and up-to-date records and documentation.
- Managing correspondence, emails and telephone enquiries professionally.
- Supporting client communications and responding to general queries.
- Preparing letters, documents and other administrative materials.
- Coordinating meetings, appointments and internal activities where required.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time.
- Maintaining filing systems and ensuring confidential information is handled appropriately.
- Following established office procedures and helping maintain efficient administrative processes.
- Assisting with general office coordination and other business support duties as required.

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Several years' experience in an administrative, office support or business support role - Essential for the experience to be within a professional services setting.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Experience maintaining records, managing documentation and following processes.
- Confident written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional and approachable manner when dealing with colleagues and clients.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to support the wider team.

GCSE Maths and English at grade 5 or above, or equivalent, are required.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Customer Service Administrator

Location: Farnham

Salary: 26,500 + Benefits

About the Role

A professional accountancy firm based in Farnham is looking for an organised, motivated and customer-focused Customer Service Administrator to join its Tax Department.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, keeping information organised and ensuring tasks are completed accurately and on time.

You will work closely with experienced Tax Specialists, providing administrative support and helping clients meet their tax obligations.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, communicating with clients, managing documentation and supporting the preparation and submission of tax returns to HMRC.

Previous experience in tax or accountancy is not essential, as full training will be provided. This position is ideal for someone who is eager to learn, develop new skills and build a career in tax administration.

Key Responsibilities

Client Communication: Communicate with clients by telephone, email and post to answer enquiries, request relevant information and provide updates on their tax returns.

Administrative Support: Assist Tax Specialists with daily administrative tasks, ensuring work is completed accurately and within required deadlines.

Financial Record-Keeping: Record and maintain financial transactions, including sales, purchases, income, receipts and payments.

Database Management: Maintain accurate client details, update databases and ensure records reflect the latest information.

Document Management: Organise and maintain electronic and paper records in accordance with internal procedures and data protection requirements.

Tax Return Support: Help gather and organise the information required to support the preparation and timely submission of clients' tax returns.

Process Improvement: Follow established procedures and identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency and the quality of client service.

Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with colleagues to support the smooth running of the Tax Department and deliver a professional service to clients.

Essential Skills and Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively.

Excellent communication skills, including a confident and professional telephone manner.

A proactive and flexible approach to work, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a busy environment.

Good attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records.

The ability to work towards targets and meet deadlines while maintaining high standards of customer service.

Good IT skills, including working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.

A positive attitude, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for developing new skills.

The ability to work independently when required and contribute positively to a team.

Desirable Experience

The following experience or knowledge would be beneficial but is not essential:

Experience working with self-employed individuals or operatives.

An understanding of personal taxation, accountancy or financial administration.

Previous experience in a customer service, office administration or finance-related role.

Salary and Benefits

The position offers a salary of 26,500 per annum, alongside the following benefits:

Full-time, permanent employment.

22 days of annual leave, increasing to 25 days with length of service.

Workplace pension through NEST, subject to applicable eligibility and enrolment criteria.

On-site parking.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Access to Medicash, including a healthcare cash plan and additional benefits.

Professional development opportunities, including training support and an ILM training partnership.

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist Customer Service, Administration Private Hospital Permanent Part-time 20hrs Farnham

Spire Clare Park Hospital are currently looking to recruit an experienced Receptionist to join the team. You will be a first point of contact at the hospital for patients, so will politely and courteously, register and direct patients, consultants and hospital teams as required, in a proactive, warm, professional and caring manner.

Located in Farnham, Spire Clare Park Hospital is a modern elective hospital rated "Good" by the CQC, offering a wide range of surgical and diagnostic services supported by state-of-the-art imaging facilities.

Duties and Responsibilities
- Welcoming, registering, including the accurate collection of credit card details and patient information.
- Directing patients, consultants and hospital teams as required, to the hospital in a warm, professional and caring manner and in such a way as to provide confidence.
- Compliance with NHS forms and processes.
- Processing in-patient/out-patient charges.
- Cash handling strictly within the parameters of the 'Handling Cash Policy'.
- Discharge of patients onto computer system ensuring accuracy of all information.
- Manage the hospital switchboard in a professional and efficient manner, ensuring all calls or enquiries are responded to in a timely manner.
- Undertake various clerical duties including checking of bed status reports, ordering and distribution of newspapers, including badges for visitors, booking taxis.

Working Hours:
- Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday - 16.30 - 20.30
- Thursday, Friday - 17.30-20.30
- Saturday - 12.00-15.00

Who we're looking for
- A personable individual with the ability to work on own initiative as well as part of a team
- Good basic PC skills, including Word, Excel and Outlook
- Excellent customer service skills
- High degree of accuracy in administration
- Great communication skills at all levels
- Experience in a customer service environment
- Experience with information management systems
- Switchboard experience

Benefits

We offer employed colleagues a competitive salary as well as a comprehensive benefits package which includes but is not limited to:
- 35 days annual leave inclusive of bank holidays
- Employer and employee contributory pension with flexible retirement options
- 'Spire for you' reward platform - discount and cashback for over 1000 retailers
- Free Bupa wellness screening
- Private medical insurance
- Life assurance
- Free off-site parking for staff

Closing Date: If we have received sufficient applications, this date may be brought forward so please submit your application as soon as possible.

For us, it's more than just treating patients; it's about looking after people.

About Us

Spire Healthcare is a leading independent healthcare group in the United Kingdom, running 38 hospitals and over 50 clinics across England, Wales and Scotland. It provides diagnostics, inpatient, day case and outpatient care, operates a network of private GPs and provides workplace health services to over 800 corporate clients. It also delivers a range of private and NHS mental health, musculoskeletal and dermatological services.

We have achieved our market leading position because of our Purpose, which is to 'make a positive difference to people's lives through outstanding personalised care'. Everyone at Spire is aligned to this purpose, which underpins a culture of respect, inclusion, passion and collaboration across our business, enabling us to achieve more than 98% of our hospitals being rated 'Good' or 'Outstanding' by the Regulators; these are sector leading standards.
